rejection_summary.title: The Big 4
rejection_summary.reason: The 141-minute Indonesian action-comedy has inventive and violent action sequences, but RogerEbert.com's whole-film review describes an extended, talk-heavy middle and highlights the prologue and final half-hour as major action peaks. The long dialogue and setup stretches make sustained action density too uncertain for today's high-density shortlist; do not infer density from the striking set pieces or genre marketing.
